title: Essence of Kreljnok
summary: Kreljnok calls adds that dramatically increase his regeneration while alive.
overview: Kreljnok calls adds that dramatically increase his regeneration while alive.

sections.title: Encounter strategy
bullets: Collect Kreljnok's Power and Kreljnok's Rage when they appear.
Prioritize those adds to return the boss's regeneration to its lower state.
A new pair is called every 150 seconds during combat; finish before the thirty-minute appearance ends.
